resolve_source_to_stream: resolve a file source (URL or local path) to a binary DocumentStream
resolve_source_to_path: resolve a file source (URL or local path) to a local file path, downloading if needed
resolve_remote_filename: extract the filename from a remote URL and its HTTP response headers
resolve_file_source: resolve a file source to a local temporary file path (deprecated)
create_document_stream: create a DocumentStream from a local file path or remote URL
